items.gist: It gives the vargodaya reckoning for day and night, with prāṇa totals and saṃkrānti measures.
It states the nine-varga reckoning, its prāṇa count and saṃkrānti, then identifies the combined day-night result as sthūla vargodaya.
It calculates prāṇas per varṇa, distinguishes day and night, and defines the external varṇodaya.
It introduces the alternative view of those who count one less, gives its varṇodaya reckoning, and concludes the kālatattva teaching.
